scope: Experimental harness and eigensolver/constraint choices only; no src/checkerboard_shell formulation was edited

issues.why_bug: An undeformed, counterclockwise unit-square quad was reported to have a non-positive corner Jacobian, contradicting its known positive mapping orientation.
issues.before: 75/75 nominal test meshes falsely marked INVALID_MESH, including uniform plate minimum scaled Jacobian -1; initial plotting aborted because no positive errors were available.
issues.after: Uniform plate minimum scaled Jacobian +1; 72/75 final Checkerboard cases solve and the three actual random-delta=0.40 inverted grids stay INVALID_MESH.
issues.repair: Use the oriented incoming/outgoing corner edges (-previous, following).

issues.why_bug: Normalizing random offsets to unit RMS before multiplying by delta made their RMS twice that of the smooth trigonometric field at the same delta.
issues.before: At delta=0.20 plate/roof/M3 random relative errors were 6.675%, 5.106%, 28.097%, respectively; six sampled random grids across the sweep were inverted.
issues.after: At exactly matched RMS, delta=0.20 errors are 1.029%, 13.696%, 13.442%, respectively; three delta=0.40 random grids are inverted and retained in the CSV.
issues.repair: Multiply each fixed-seed random component by the matching smooth-field interior RMS.

issues.why_bug: Unshifted ARPACK `which=SM` failed to converge in the large zero eigenspace of the sphere n=16 J_bW observation after 6085 iterations (zero of 20 requested eigenvectors).
issues.before: ARPACK error -1 and no spectrum for this operator.
issues.after: The same exact AD Hessian evaluated by LAPACK's symmetric subset driver yields the first eigenvalue 1.320e-5 and 20 saved eigenpairs at sphere n=16.
issues.repair: Change only the spectral eigensolver; retain observation energy and exact AD Hessian.

issues.why_bug: Fixing a single raw corner plus isolated scalar pins does not eliminate mixed rigid translations and three-component alternating raw gauge in the quotient; three exact full-tangent zeros had large physical midpoint motion on both strips.
issues.before: Flat n=8 full-tangent first three eigenvalues approximately -3.77e-18, normalized alternating score 0.703 for each; the same count appeared at n=16,32 and on the cylinder.
issues.after: With a local 2x2 raw corner block, the minimum flat n=8 full-tangent eigenvalue is +1.443e-7 and cylindrical n=8 is +1.485e-7; no exact full-tangent zeros remain at n=8/16/32.
issues.repair: Remove mixed rigid/gauge degrees via four corner-block raw nodes; this slightly strengthens physical BC and is explicitly reported.
